note: Straight-alpha RGBA layers, far to near. Each PNG includes the overscan margin; place its top-left at `offset` in painting coordinates. depth: suggested parallax factor (0 = sky ... 1 = nearest). flat.png = all layers composited with normal blending.

layers.name: sky
layers.note: golden sky in the gap above the robot; opaque

layers.name: far
layers.note: far trunks converging up into the high canopy around the gap

layers.name: canopy
layers.note: giant trunks rising at the sides into the dark canopy around the gap

layers.name: beams
layers.note: sunbeams down through the gap onto the face (robot goes above or below: above for silhouette, below for light on the face)
